# Abecedarium

Abecedarium styles Obsidian for a clean, readable interface built on typography and spacing. Its recorded description names subtle colour accents and a clear visual hierarchy meant to keep attention on the note text. Nothing further about its palette, its modes or its settings is recorded.

![Abecedarium screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zalenza/Abecedarium-theme/HEAD/abecedarium_dark.png)

```cue

    name:   "Abecedarium"
    author: "zalenza"
```
